title: Revision verification history
responsibility: Shows a revision’s recorded verification runs, scenarios and captured evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.summary
inputs.description: Required revision summary supplying commit metadata, coverage, gaps and record validation problems.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.detail
inputs.description: Required full revision whose verification records and evidence are displayed.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required address prefix for captured media and other artifact links.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.exportHref
inputs.description: Required record-download address. Empty hides the download; otherwise the selected record identifier is appended as a query parameter.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.record
inputs.description: Optional requested record identifier. If absent or not found, chooses a valid passed record, then the first record, then none.

inputs.name: HarnessHistory.onrecord
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving a clicked record identifier. Defaults to doing nothing; the host must update the selected record.

outputs.name: HarnessHistory
outputs.description: Revision metadata and coverage notice, selectable run records with failures, and the chosen run’s scenario outcomes, inherited results, exemptions and artifacts. Selects the requested record when found, otherwise a valid passed record, then the first record. Non-media artifacts receive links or explicit gaps; screenshot and audio evidence appears in the gallery. A supplied export address adds a download for the selected record.
